cur = conn.cursor()
cur.execute(\"SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'\")
tables = cur.fetchall()
print('Tables:', tables)
for t in tables:
    tname = t[0]
    cur.execute(f'PRAGMA table_info({tname})')
    cols = cur.fetchall()
    print(f'\nTable {tname} columns:', cols)
    cur.execute(f'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {tname}')
    cnt = cur.fetchone()[0]
    print(f'  Row count: {cnt}')
conn.close()
